systems.identity_basis: Source SNaft/SAntr structures and SI molecular-coordinate records establish the full sulfonamide graphs. Public entries contain no V/Z basin labels, optimized conformers or assigned intramolecular contact.
systems.state_definition: This entry defines chemical identity, not a required conformer, optimized geometry or selected excited state. Any additional state/model used must be explicitly related to this identity.
systems.atom_mapping: Atom maps identify graph atoms, not coordinates. Preserve or document a bijective mapping in generated structures; identify added hydrogens by their parent atom.

identity_scope: Study the two complete supplied neutral singlet sulfonamide identities. In-vacuo and methanol settings define the molecular scope; any environmental treatment must be stated. No conformer family, preferred torsion or conformational ordering is supplied as a fact. Compare relative energies or populations only within a consistent composition, environment and thermodynamic convention. Ionization equilibria, crystal packing, membrane permeability and antifungal activity are outside the required question.
provenance: Chemical identities and molecular-medium definitions from main computational study and SI TableS8. Source optimized structures/energy rankings and interaction assignments are private.
